description: Implementation of various IOBuffer classes in the net namespace, including IOBuffer, IOBufferWithSize, StringIOBuffer, DrainableIOBuffer, GrowableIOBuffer, PickledIOBuffer, and WrappedIOBuffer, with functions for buffer management, size validation, and memory handling.

classes.name: IOBuffer
classes.description: Base class for buffer management, providing data pointer and basic constructors/destructors.

classes.name: IOBufferWithSize
classes.description: Extends IOBuffer to include size management.

classes.name: StringIOBuffer
classes.description: Handles string-based buffers, allowing construction from std::string.

classes.name: DrainableIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that supports consuming bytes and tracking remaining data.

classes.name: GrowableIOBuffer
classes.description: Resizable buffer with capacity management and memory reallocation.

classes.name: PickledIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that supports serialization/deserialization via a pickle object.

classes.name: WrappedIOBuffer
classes.description: Wraps existing const data into an IOBuffer.

methods.name: AssertValidBufferSize
methods.description: Validates buffer size, accepting both size_t and int.

methods.name: SetCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of GrowableIOBuffer, reallocating memory as needed.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the current offset within GrowableIOBuffer.

methods.name: DidConsume
methods.description: Marks bytes as consumed in DrainableIOBuffer.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Finalizes PickledIOBuffer by updating data pointer from pickle.
